content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define the terms gene, chromosome, and genome
Describe the relationship between DNA, genes, and chromosomes
Explain how DNA is organised in cells
State the human chromosome number and explain what diploid and haploid mean
DNA doesn't just float freely in the cell - it is organised into structures called
. Within chromosomes, specific sections of DNA called
contain the instructions for making proteins. Understanding how genetic information is organised is essential for understanding inheritance.
